about: Measured off the model files by tools/printer-motion-measured.mjs (fix-0.6.2 WO-08, 2026-10-30). Merged field by field over the other motion and print-frame tables. `flex` names the parts that are moved vertex by vertex: belts and tubes (web/model-follow.js).

notices: Axis values are displacements from the model's pose: the bed slides in Y, the beam climbs in Z, the head runs along the beam.
Measured off the model file by tools/printer-motion-measured.mjs (2026-10-30). Firmware, belt tension and collisions are not simulated.
siboor_sboom_220.scope: Movement preview from the live position, from the groups in the model's own part records.
siboor_sboom_220.calibration_basis: Measured from the model: the PEI surface (part 00368) is centred at X 0.353, Z 17.158, top 114.11; the nozzle tip (part 00481, its lowest vertices) is at X 0.002, height 214.954, Z 3.003. X0 and Y0 are the corner of the 220 mm print area centred on that surface, Y0 its front edge; Z0 the surface touching the nozzle. The Z travel is the catalogue's 220 mm.

notices: Axis values are displacements from the model's pose: the gantry climbs in Z, the X beam runs in Y on it, the head in X on the beam.
This CAD has no belts and no drag chains, so none are drawn.
Measured off the model file by tools/printer-motion-measured.mjs (2026-10-30). Firmware, belt tension and collisions are not simulated.
doomcube2_350_reference.scope: Movement preview from the live position. The file has no part records: the assemblies are told apart by where each body stands.
doomcube2_350_reference.calibration_basis: Measured from the model: the plate (part 1176) is centred at X 0, Z -39, top 143.976; the nozzle tip (body part_592..._24, its lowest vertices) is at X 0.041, height 301.955, Z 74.024, 157.979 mm over the plate. The print area is the 350 mm centred on the plate, with its front on the door's side (-Z). The Z travel is 350 mm: the Z rails are 400 mm with 30 mm carriages.

notices: Axis values are displacements from the model's pose: the bed drops as Z rises.
With the options 'Trident R2 gantry and X carriage' and 'Stealthburner on the Trident R2 carriage' chosen, the X beam moves with Y and the head with X and Y, as the parts of those files say.

The bed stands 5.759 mm over its CAD pose at Z 0: the Stealthburner on the R2 carriage (the toolhead of voron_trident_500_custom, whose carriage frames stand at the same height, 318.995, as the 300's module) has its nozzle tip at X -0.008, height 309.009, Z 35.9, that far over the plate in the model's pose.
Measured off the model file by tools/printer-motion-measured.mjs (2026-10-30). Firmware, belt tension and collisions are not simulated.

siboor_sboom_220.basis: Measured from the model (mm, display frame, Y up): the PEI surface is centred at X 0.353, Z 17.158, top 114.11; the 220 mm print area is centred on it and Y0 is its front edge (+Z). The nozzle tip is 100.844 mm over the plate in the model's pose.

doomcube2_350_reference.basis: Measured from the model (mm, display frame, Y up): the plate is centred at X 0, Z -39, top 143.976; the 350 mm print area is centred on it. The machine's front is -Z (its door and the head's face), so Y0 is the -Z edge and printer X runs toward -X in the display, as the CAD's own axes do.
